about: The same presses as stage-2-clear, then nothing. After the map the third stage starts, in the cave, at frame 17477. Bats hang along the ceiling and let go when Arthur is below them, drop toward his height and fly at him in a wave, and zombies come out of the ground. With nothing pressed a zombie knocks his armour off at 17589 and another kills him at 17829: his bones, and the screen that says whose turn it is.
